name: Marta Kowalczyk
headline: Data Engineer specializing in cloud pipelines and analytics infrastructure
summary: Data Engineer with 5 years of experience designing and maintaining scalable ETL/ELT pipelines on Google Cloud Platform. Skilled in Python, SQL, and Airflow orchestration, with a strong focus on data quality, automation, and collaboration with analytics teams to deliver reliable data solutions.

responsibilities: Design and maintain ETL pipelines using Airflow and Python for ingesting data from multiple sources into BigQuery
Optimize SQL queries and data models to improve reporting performance for analytics teams
Implement CI/CD pipelines for data workflows using Cloud Build and GitHub Actions
Collaborate with data scientists to prepare curated datasets for machine learning projects
Monitor pipeline health and troubleshoot data quality issues in production
Built and maintained batch data pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow
Migrated on-premise data warehouse workloads to Google Cloud Platform
Wrote SQL transformations and views to support internal reporting dashboards
Assisted senior engineers in setting up monitoring and alerting for data jobs
Supported reporting processes by writing SQL queries against relational databases
Automated recurring data extraction tasks using Python scripts
Prepared dashboards and summary reports for internal stakeholders
